Select exact IC50 activity rows for human Fibroblast Growth Factor Receptor 1 (CHEMBL3650). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Require canonical_smiles to be present and at least one of pubmed_id or DOI to be available. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id and docs on compound_records.doc_id for provenance. Inner join compound_structures to enforce SMILES presence. Filter by target CHEMBL ID CHEMBL3650 and standard_type IC50. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
